name: Intendante des gourdes
description: Athletic adult female, dark brown hide with gold flecks, wide cranial crest, unmasked face, thick dreads half tied in a knot. Layered sand shawl tucked at chest, practical bronze breast protection, split cloth over trousers. Three different-size blue-glass water canteens firmly strapped across torso; carries one squat ceramic-and-bronze water jug by its handle at thigh. Free hand on pack strap.
prompt:

Image2 is reference ONLY for cinematic realistically handpainted 2D game rendering, body proportions, readable silhouette and slightly elevated three-quarter camera FACING RIGHT. One NEW distinct individual, never a recoloured copy. Canonical alien Yautja cranium, four mandibles when face is exposed, tendril dreadlocks and clawed hands/feet. Working logistics specialist in calm idle stance, not combat. All baggage must be physically attached, held or strapped; no loose items around character. Crisp silhouette, detailed convincing textiles and weathered metal, soft overhead-left lighting. Full body head-to-toes and ALL equipment must fit inside frame with at least8% empty margin every side; do not crop. Genuine transparent alpha background. No scenery, backdrop, ground, platform, floor shadow, glow cloud, text, readable writing, numbers, labels, watermark, border, extra person, collage or atlas. No magical staff. At ordinary game sprite scale, face, posture, clothes and cargo shape must distinguish this person.
Distinct individual design: Athletic adult female, dark brown hide with gold flecks, wide cranial crest, unmasked face, thick dreads half tied in a knot. Layered sand shawl tucked at chest, practical bronze breast protection, split cloth over trousers.
